intro.en: Instrument and sensor harnesses connect sensing elements, transmitters, gauges, acquisition modules and controllers. They may carry low-level analog signals, digital communication, excitation power or mixed circuits.
intro.zh: 仪表与传感器线束连接传感元件、变送器、仪表、采集模块和控制器，可能承载低电平模拟信号、数字通信、激励电源或混合回路。

knowledge.en: Signal type determines whether twisted pairs, shielding, drain wires or controlled grounding are needed. Shield termination, reference ground and separation from noisy power circuits must follow the equipment design rather than a generic rule.
knowledge.zh: 信号类型决定是否需要双绞、屏蔽、排流线或特定接地方式。屏蔽端接、参考地以及与干扰性动力回路的间距，应依据设备设计确定，不能套用单一规则。

notes.en: Provide the sensor and controller models, signal type, pin definition, supply voltage, connector orientation, required shielding and installation environment. For calibrated systems, define which calibration or functional checks remain the customer's responsibility.
notes.zh: 需要提供传感器与控制器型号、信号类型、针脚定义、供电电压、接口方向、屏蔽要求和安装环境；涉及校准的系统，还应明确哪些校准或功能验证由客户完成。

delivery.en: Pin routing, conductor and shield construction are reviewed before sampling. Continuity, insulation where specified, shield termination and labels are checked to the approved drawing; signal performance testing is agreed separately when required.
delivery.zh: 打样前审核针脚路径、导体与屏蔽结构；依据确认图纸检查导通、约定的绝缘项目、屏蔽端接和标签，若需要信号性能测试则另行约定。

subtitle.en: From the sensing point to the acquisition system
subtitle.zh: 从感知端到采集系统的完整连接

lead.en: Instrument and sensor harness is a broad product family rather than one universal lead. It includes compact internal jumpers, shielded analog cables, thermocouple and RTD extensions, transmitter leads, encoder branches and multi-channel acquisition looms. Each assembly is developed around the real sensor, instrument, signal type, connector and installation environment.
lead.zh: 仪表与传感器线束不是一种通用线缆，而是覆盖机内短跳线、屏蔽模拟量线、热电偶与RTD延长线、变送器连接线、编码器分支和多通道采集线束的一整类产品。每一款都需要围绕真实传感器、仪表、信号类型、接口和安装环境开发。

advantages.zh: 仪表与传感器线束类型

method.en: Instrument and Sensor Harness Making Method
method.zh: 仪表与传感器线束制作方法

title.zh: 模拟量传感器与变送器线束

copy.en: Connects voltage, current-loop, bridge or other defined analog signals between sensing elements, transmitters, displays and acquisition modules.
copy.zh: 连接电压、电流环、电桥或其他已定义模拟信号，用于传感元件、变送器、显示仪表与采集模块之间的互连。

copy.en: Conductor and extension-wire type, polarity, junction treatment, connector and ambient temperature are kept consistent with the measurement system.
copy.zh: 导体与补偿线类型、极性、接点处理、接口和环境温度需与测量系统保持一致。

title.zh: 数字传感器与现场总线线束

copy.en: Supports defined interfaces such as encoder, serial, CAN or industrial communication circuits with the required pair structure, shielding and pin map.
copy.zh: 按项目支持编码器、串行、CAN或工业通信回路，并匹配所需线对结构、屏蔽与针脚定义。

title.zh: 密封型现场传感器线束

copy.en: Combines compatible housings, terminals, seals, cable diameter and branch protection for sensors exposed to splash, dust, oil or outdoor mounting.
copy.zh: 针对飞溅、粉尘、油污或户外安装环境，组合兼容的壳体、端子、密封件、线径与分支防护。

title.zh: 面板仪表与指示器线束

copy.en: Organizes power, signal, alarm and communication links behind panels where orientation, service access and installation order are constrained.
copy.zh: 在面板背部空间受限的环境中整理供电、信号、报警和通信连接，并兼顾接口方向、检修空间与装配顺序。

copy.en: Routes multiple sensing channels to DAQ, I/O or test systems with defined channel labels, breakout positions, reference conductors and shield treatment.
copy.zh: 将多路传感通道连接至DAQ、I/O或测试系统，并明确通道标签、分线位置、参考导体和屏蔽处理。

copy.en: Wire size, strand construction, pair twist and resistance are selected from signal level, distance, flexing, termination and system requirements.
copy.zh: 根据信号电平、距离、弯曲工况、端接方式与系统要求选择线径、绞合结构、线对节距和电阻特性。

title.en: Shield, drain wire and reference ground

copy.en: Foil, braid, drain wire and termination method are defined with the controller grounding architecture; shielding is not added or grounded by appearance alone.
copy.zh: 铝箔、编织、排流线与端接方式需要配合控制器接地架构定义，不能只凭外观决定是否增加或连接屏蔽。

copy.en: Insulation, jacket, sleeve, conduit or braid are reviewed against temperature, oil, abrasion, chemicals, installation space and movement.
copy.zh: 绝缘、护套、套管、波纹管或编织层需结合温度、油污、磨损、化学环境、安装空间与运动条件审核。

title.zh: 连接器、端子与传感器接口

copy.en: Housing family, keying, terminal, plating, seal, sensor-side interface and mating orientation are confirmed as one compatible connection system.
copy.zh: 壳体系列、防错、端子、镀层、密封件、传感器端接口与对插方向需作为一个兼容系统共同确认。

title.en: Build from sensor and instrument data
title.zh: 依据传感器与仪表资料开发

copy.en: Model numbers, manuals, pin tables, signal type, supply, measurement range and connector drawings are converted into a reviewed interconnect definition.
copy.zh: 把型号、手册、针脚表、信号类型、供电、测量范围和接口图转化为经过审核的互连定义。

title.en: Match an existing cable or sample

copy.en: A sample can establish dimensions, visible construction and mating interfaces, while hidden circuits, compensation materials and calibration responsibility still require confirmation.
copy.zh: 样品可用于确认尺寸、可见结构和对插接口，但隐藏回路、补偿材料与校准责任仍需另行确认。

title.zh: 将敏感信号与动力回路分开

copy.en: Routing, spacing, pair layout, shield termination and branch points are coordinated with the machine to reduce avoidable coupling into low-level circuits.
copy.zh: 结合设备协调路径、间距、线对布局、屏蔽端接和分支点，减少动力回路对低电平信号的不必要耦合。

title.zh: 处理停产或难采购接口

copy.en: Alternative parts are compared by mating compatibility, terminal system, electrical rating, sealing, material and documented approval rather than appearance.
copy.zh: 替代件按对插兼容、端子系统、电气额定、密封、材料与书面批准进行比较，不只比外观。

copy.en: Bench instruments, DAQ modules, test fixtures, reference sensors and replaceable test leads.
copy.zh: 台式仪表、DAQ采集模块、测试工装、参考传感器和可更换测试线。

copy.en: Photoelectric, proximity, temperature, pressure, position and weighing sensors distributed across a production machine.
copy.zh: 分布在生产设备中的光电、接近、温度、压力、位置和称重传感器。

title.zh: 水处理、能源与环境监测

copy.en: Level, flow, pressure, conductivity and condition-monitoring instruments installed around pumps, tanks and treatment systems.
copy.zh: 安装在泵、储罐与处理系统周围的液位、流量、压力、电导率及状态监测仪表。

copy.en: Encoders, limit sensors, tool probes, temperature points and condition-monitoring devices inside machines.
copy.zh: 机床内部的编码器、限位传感器、对刀探头、温度测点与状态监测装置。

copy.en: Internal sensor interconnects, pumps, valves, detectors, acquisition boards and front-panel instruments.
copy.zh: 连接内部传感器、泵、阀、检测器、采集板与前面板仪表。

copy.en: Position, force, vision-trigger, safety and process sensors linked to local I/O and controllers.
copy.zh: 将位置、力、视觉触发、安全与工艺传感器连接至现场I/O和控制器。

copy.en: Confirm sensor, instrument, signal type, supply, pin map, mating interface, route and environment.
copy.zh: 确认传感器、仪表、信号类型、供电、针脚、对插接口、路径和环境。

copy.en: Define conductor, pair, shield, ground, protection, branch datum, labels and connector direction.
copy.zh: 定义导体、线对、屏蔽、接地、防护、分支基准、标签与接口方向。

copy.en: Verify wire, connector, terminal, seal, sleeve, label and any approved alternative before build.
copy.zh: 制作前核对线材、连接器、端子、密封、套管、标签及认可替代。

copy.en: Cut, strip, terminate, assemble, shield, protect and form the harness to the reviewed documents.
copy.zh: 依据审核文件完成下线、剥线、端接、组装、屏蔽、防护与成型。

copy.en: Check circuit mapping, continuity, polarity, isolation and shield termination according to the approved plan.
copy.zh: 按批准计划检查回路对应、导通、极性、隔离与屏蔽端接。

copy.en: Fit, signal behavior, calibration or functional checks are completed on an agreed setup with responsibilities recorded.
copy.zh: 在约定装置上完成装配、信号表现、校准或功能验证，并记录责任边界。

copy.en: The harness is reviewed as part of the complete sensor-to-instrument chain; cable construction alone cannot guarantee measurement performance.
copy.zh: 把线束作为传感器至仪表完整测量链路的一部分审核，不能只凭线缆结构保证测量性能。

copy.en: Power separation, reference ground and shield termination follow the controller and installation architecture, with any performance test agreed by project.
copy.zh: 动力隔离、参考地与屏蔽端接需服从控制器和安装架构，性能测试方法按项目约定。

copy.en: Thermocouple or temperature-measurement circuits require the specified conductor or extension type, polarity and junction treatment across the expected environment.
copy.zh: 热电偶或温度测量回路需要在预期环境中保持指定导体或补偿类型、极性与接点处理。

copy.en: Clamp spacing, service loop, sleeve, backshell and strain relief are reviewed to keep repeated mechanical load away from terminals and sensor exits.
copy.zh: 审核固定间距、检修余量、套管、尾附件与应力防护，减少端子和传感器出线处的重复机械载荷。

copy.en: Defined labels, colors, breakouts and connector directions help installation and troubleshooting follow the approved channel map.
copy.zh: 明确标签、颜色、分线与接口方向，使安装和排查能够依据已批准通道表进行。

copy.en: Service loops and replaceable interface sections can shorten access work without disturbing unrelated sensing channels.
copy.zh: 检修余量和可更换接口段可减少拆装工作，并避免扰动无关传感通道。

copy.en: An approved pin map, material list, shield treatment and inspection plan are carried into later production batches.
copy.zh: 把已批准针脚表、物料清单、屏蔽处理和检验计划延续到后续生产批次。

title.en: A harness matched to the instrument system

copy.en: Sensor function, signal path, environment, installation and validation responsibility are handled as one project instead of adapting a generic cable.
copy.zh: 把传感功能、信号路径、环境、安装与验证责任作为一个项目处理，而不是勉强套用通用线缆。

q.en: Is an instrument and sensor harness a fixed product model?
q.zh: 仪表与传感器线束是固定型号吗？

a.en: No. It is a family covering many sensors, instruments, signal types, interfaces and environments. The final harness is defined by the actual measurement system.
a.zh: 不是。它覆盖多种传感器、仪表、信号类型、接口与环境，最终结构由真实测量系统定义。

q.en: What information is needed for a quotation?
q.zh: 报价需要提供哪些资料？

a.en: Provide sensor and instrument models, manuals or drawings, signal type, supply, pin map, connector data, route, length, environment, quantity and required inspections.
a.zh: 建议提供传感器与仪表型号、手册或图纸、信号类型、供电、针脚表、接口资料、路径、长度、环境、数量和检验要求。

q.en: Can you copy an existing sensor cable?
q.zh: 可以按现有传感器线缆复制吗？

a.en: A sample can define dimensions and visible construction, but signal function, hidden components, compensation material and calibration responsibility must still be confirmed.
a.zh: 样品可用于确认尺寸和可见结构，但信号功能、隐藏元件、补偿材料与校准责任仍需确认。

q.en: Does every sensor cable need shielding?
q.zh: 所有传感器线缆都需要屏蔽吗？

a.en: No. The need and termination method depend on signal level, interface, cable length, surrounding circuits, grounding architecture and equipment documentation.
a.zh: 不一定。是否需要以及如何端接，取决于信号电平、接口、线长、周边回路、接地架构与设备资料。

q.en: Can thermocouple extension wire be replaced by ordinary copper wire?
q.zh: 热电偶延长线可以用普通铜线替代吗？

a.en: Not without system review. Thermocouple circuits may require a specified extension or compensating conductor type and correct polarity across the measurement chain.
a.zh: 不能未经审核直接替代。热电偶回路可能要求指定延长或补偿导体类型，并在测量链路中保持正确极性。

q.en: Which checks are performed before shipment?

a.en: Finished harnesses receive continuity and appearance inspection. Pin mapping, polarity, insulation, shield termination, dimensions or signal-related checks are added when defined in the approved project plan.
a.zh: 成品进行导通与外观检查；针脚对应、极性、绝缘、屏蔽端接、尺寸或信号相关项目按已批准项目计划增加。
